evals.prompt: I found this Reddit comment: 'Every time my agent gets stuck in a loop I have to manually inspect dozens of tool calls to figure out where it went wrong. Took me 3 hours last night.' Mine this signal.
evals.expected_output: Extracts complaint ('manually inspect dozens of tool calls'), trigger ('agent gets stuck in a loop'), current_behavior ('manual inspection'), cost ('3 hours'). Separates FACT (stated behavior/cost) from ASSUMPTION (no leap to 'they need a debugging platform'). Creates one cluster, confidence weak.

assertions.name: Extracts complaint/trigger/behavior/cost
assertions.description: All four fields present and grounded in the text

assertions.name: Separates fact from assumption
assertions.description: No solution/need leap presented as fact; any 'they need X' is labeled assumption

assertions.name: Creates one cluster with weak confidence
assertions.description: Single signal, single source → confidence weak, next_action keep mining

evals.prompt: Signal A: 'Agent keeps looping and I have to trace tool calls manually — we need an observability tool.' Signal B: 'My agent reran three times and I still can't see the execution state — considering a debugger.' Mine both.
evals.expected_output: Merges A and B into ONE cluster (job=debug agent execution, friction=can't see root cause) despite A mentioning observability tool and B mentioning debugger. Confidence medium (2 signals, 2 sources).

assertions.name: Merges into one cluster
assertions.description: Both signals under one cluster id

assertions.name: Matches by job+friction not product words
assertions.description: Does not split into 'observability' and 'debugger' clusters

evals.prompt: Signal A: 'My AI agent can't be debugged when it loops.' Signal B: 'My AI agent is too slow at inference.' Mine both.
evals.expected_output: Splits into TWO clusters (A: debug; B: speed) despite both containing 'AI agent'. Different jobs/frictions must not be merged.

assertions.name: Two clusters
assertions.description: A and B land in different clusters

assertions.name: Not fooled by shared keyword
assertions.description: Does not merge just because both mention 'AI agent'

evals.prompt: Someone tweeted: 'Every SaaS company needs an AI agent that auto-updates their docs.' Mine this signal.
evals.expected_output: Flags the product/market claim as ASSUMPTION, not fact. No concrete complaint/trigger/behavior/cost can be extracted from a solution assertion. Marks low-signal and notes missing specificity.

assertions.name: Solution claim flagged as assumption
assertions.description: 'needs an AI agent' is labeled assumption, never written as fact

assertions.name: No invented evidence
assertions.description: Does not fabricate a complaint/trigger/cost that isn't in the text

evals.prompt: Append this signal to the existing cluster 'agent-loop-debugging' (already has 2 signals from 2 independent sources): 'Third dev this week: wasted half a day tracing a loop in production.' Mine it.
evals.expected_output: Appends to the existing cluster, signal_count 3, independent_sources 3, cost ('half a day') now stated → confidence flips to strong, next_action becomes 'hand off to idea-validation'.

assertions.name: Appends to existing cluster
assertions.description: Does not create a new cluster; existing id is reused

assertions.name: Confidence strong + handoff
assertions.description: 3 signals, 3 sources, concrete cost → strong, next_action = hand off

assertions.name: State reflects the append
assertions.description: state/problem_clusters.json reflects the appended signal and updated confidence
